definitions.gloss: many times, time and again, repeatedly
definitions.explanation: A literary or formal way of saying 'many times.' Often used in written narratives, speeches, and formal contexts. More elevated in register than 何度も.

examples.japanese: {幾度|いくど}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
{幾度|いくど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}された→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦{過|あやま}ち→過ち：14376_ayamachi⟧だ。
examples.english: It is a mistake that has been repeated time and again.

examples.japanese: {幾度|いくど}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧してきた。
examples.english: This company has grown by overcoming crises many times over.

notes:
{幾度|いくど} is a literary equivalent of ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧ (how many times / many times).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {幾度|いくど}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: many times (emphatic)
- {幾度|いくど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: countless times, time and again
- {幾度|いくど}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: several times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: many times (neutral, everyday)
- {幾度|いくど}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: many times (literary, formal)
- {度々|たびたび}: repeatedly, often (slightly formal)

RELATED WORDS:
{幾度|いくど} uses the kanji ⟦{幾|いく}→幾〜：00444_iku⟧, which means "how many" and appears in other literary expressions like ⟦{幾多|いくた}→幾多：12642_ikuta⟧ (many, numerous) and {幾年|いくとせ} (many years).
